id: title:haacked:leave a flag property untyped when stored types disagree

review.posthog_relevance: Preserves group-targeting property type and group_type_index when an incoming flag edit omits an operator, while still matching stored filters. This supports the group-aggregated set's ability to retain its own group type and index against a person-aggregated source, rather than defaulting to group or rejecting.
review.reason: Adds a helper function evaluatedOperator and its use, replacing direct ?? 'exact' with a dedicated lookup. P1.F1.H3.
